title: Career Roadmap · Drone Technician
summary: A Drone Technician assembles, inspects, tests, maintains and repairs unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), including flight controllers, motors, batteries, sensors, communication systems and associated software.

facts.Current degree: ITI Drone Technician / Drone Service & Maintenance / Electronics and Aviation-related training

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 for eligible vocational courses; Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics can broaden technical and aviation-related study options.

blocks.text: DGT lists Drone Technician as a six-month, 600-hour CTS course. Its published eligibility specifies Class 10 with Science and Mathematics, or a relevant vocational subject or equivalent. Individual institutes may publish additional admission details.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Drone components, electrical basics, batteries, sensors, tools and safety.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Technical skills
blocks.text: Assembly, wiring, flight-controller configuration, calibration and fault diagnosis.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced practice
blocks.text: Preventive maintenance, firmware updates, telemetry, testing and repair documentation.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Complete supervised repair projects, build a technical portfolio and practise service reporting.

Important distinction
blocks.text: A Drone Technician qualification does not automatically authorize commercial drone piloting. Piloting may require separate training and certification under applicable DGCA rules.

blocks.label: Typical pathway

blocks.text: Some countries and employers may require local aviation, electrical or workplace-safety credentials. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.

Student ↓ Drone Technician Trainee ↓ Drone Assembly / Repair Technician ↓ UAV Service Technician ↓ Senior Technician / Diagnostic Specialist ↓ Maintenance Supervisor / Service Coordinator ↓ Technical Manager / UAV Service Entrepreneur

CLASS 10 WITH REQUIRED SUBJECTS ↓ DGT DRONE TECHNICIAN COURSE OR RELEVANT TECHNICAL QUALIFICATION ↓ ELECTRONICS + DRONE COMPONENT SKILLS ↓ ASSEMBLY, TESTING + REPAIR PROJECTS ↓ APPRENTICESHIP / SUPERVISED FIELD EXPERIENCE ↓ DRONE TECHNICIAN / UAV SERVICE ROLE ↓ ADVANCED ELECTRONICS / ROBOTICS SPECIALIZATION ↓ SENIOR TECHNICIAN / SUPERVISOR / SERVICE BUSINESS

Verify current official notifications for admissions, scholarships, certifications and drone regulations. Prioritize hands-on repair skills, battery safety, careful documentation and supervised practical training.
